name: Redmine Link Cards
description: Private Redmine link cards with personal API keys and permission-aware caches.

settings.help_text: HTTPS base URL, including an optional installation subpath. Set this before enabling link previews.
Fallback 32-byte encryption secret (base64). Prefer MM_REDMINE_ENCRYPTION_KEY supplied to the Mattermost process outside its database. Use the same secret on every HA node.
